en.title: Managing Category Quota Limits
en.excerpt: Configuring participant caps per division to match physical target butt capacity and range scheduling limits.
en.content:
Role of Category Quota Management

Setting maximum participant caps per category ensures that registrations match the physical capacity of your archery range (total target butts multiplied by maximum archers per butt) and prevents overbooking.

Setting Individual Participant Caps

In the Edit Category modal, enter the numeric limit in the Maximum Participants field (e.g., 32 or 64). Setting this value automatically formats future elimination brackets to standard tournament sizes (Top 16, Top 32).

Real-Time Slot Depletion Counters

Public registration pages feature live slot counters (e.g., "28 of 32 slots filled"). When an athlete completes checkout, the counter decrements in real time across all viewing browsers.

Handling Sold-Out Divisions

Once a category reaches 100% capacity, the registration button automatically locks. Organizers can increase the cap at any time from the dashboard if additional target butts become available on the field.
